map.评估面部毛细血管扩张（红血丝）的面积占比、血管类型与严重程度，提供治疗参考: Assesses the area fraction, vessel type, and severity of facial capillary dilation (spider veins), providing a treatment reference
map.激光术前设计：按面积把治疗区分成小格，估算所需脉冲数与能量总量。: Pre-laser planning: divide the treatment area into small cells by area to estimate the pulse count and total energy needed.
map.疗效量化：治疗前后同法测算面积差，用百分比呈现改善幅度。: Quantify efficacy: measure the area by the same method before and after and express the improvement as a percentage.
map.日常记录：把红血丝变化变成可追踪的数字，减少主观「好像淡了」的误判。: Daily tracking: turn changes in spider veins into trackable numbers, reducing the subjective "it looks lighter" misjudgment.
map.：治疗前面积占比 12%、治疗后 5% → 相对退缩 58%，记录为有效；剩余可: : an area share of 12% before and 5% after means a 58% relative reduction, recorded as effective; the remainder can be treated with maintenance sessions.

map.所有红血丝都适合激光吗？: Is Laser Suitable for All Spider Veins?
map.不一定。细表浅扩张对染料/强脉冲光反应好，深层或伴炎症需先控因，遵医嘱。: Not always. Fine superficial dilation responds well to dye lasers and IPL, while deep or inflamed cases need the cause addressed first — follow your doctor's advice.
map.面积算出来要忌口吗？: Do I Need to Change My Diet After Getting the Area?
map.本工具不提供医嘱。玫瑰痤疮相关扩张通常建议避热辣酒精，具体听医生。: This tool does not give medical advice. For rosacea-related dilation, avoiding heat, spicy food, and alcohol is commonly advised — follow your doctor.
map.自己测的能当复诊依据吗？: Can My Own Measurement Substitute for a Follow-up Visit?
map.可作参考，但复诊以机构VISIA/专业影像为准，自测仅看趋势。: It can serve as a reference, but follow-ups should rely on clinic VISIA or professional imaging; self-measurement only shows trends.
